input: I got a job offer in Bengaluru. I currently live with my parents, I'm comfortable with my current job, I have a relationship here, and I've always wanted to build a startup. The new job pays 40% more.
reworded_input: A company in Bengaluru offered me a role at 40% above my current pay. Right now I live at home with my parents, I like my job well enough, my partner is in this city, and starting my own company has always been the plan.
notes: Flagship scenario. The percentage is grounded; the absolute salary is not.
